description: This file contains TypeScript code for integrating Microsoft Teams SDK, including lazy loading of SDK modules, creating no-op HTTP plugins, managing Teams app instances, token providers, activity handling, and JWT validation for Teams authentication.

classes.name: MSTeamsTeamsSdk
classes.description: Type defining the structure of lazily loaded Teams SDK modules, including App and Client.

classes.name: MSTeamsApp
classes.description: Type representing an instance of the Teams SDK App used for token management and messaging.

classes.name: MSTeamsTokenProvider
classes.description: Type for token provider with a method to get access tokens for specified scopes.

classes.name: MSTeamsBotIdentity
classes.description: Type representing the identity of a Teams bot, including optional id and name.

classes.name: MSTeamsSendContext
classes.description: Type for context used to send, update, and delete activities within Teams.

classes.name: MSTeamsProcessContext
classes.description: Type extending send context with activity details and batch sending capabilities.

methods.name: loadMSTeamsSdk
methods.description: Asynchronously loads Teams SDK modules (@microsoft/teams.apps and @microsoft/teams.api).

methods.name: createNoOpHttpPlugin
methods.description: Creates a no-operation HTTP plugin stub to satisfy Teams SDK plugin discovery without starting an Express server.

methods.name: createMSTeamsApp
methods.description: Creates a Teams SDK App instance from provided credentials, managing token acquisition and JWT validation.

methods.name: createMSTeamsTokenProvider
methods.description: Builds a token provider that uses the Teams SDK App for obtaining access tokens.

methods.name: createMSTeamsAdapter
methods.description: Builds a Teams SDK adapter for handling conversation continuation, processing requests, and activity management.

methods.name: loadMSTeamsSdkWithAuth
methods.description: Loads the Teams SDK and creates an app instance with authentication using provided credentials.

methods.name: createBotFrameworkJwtValidator
methods.description: Creates a JWT validator supporting multi-issuer validation for Teams bot authentication.
